title: Tricanonical very ampleness and first-cohomology vanishing for proper nodal curves of genus at least two with ample dualizing sheaf and ground-field global functions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must separate all degree-two subschemes even on reducible nodal curves. It reduces the obstruction to numerical inequalities on every connected subcurve, excludes rational tails and bridges using canonical ampleness, and handles the whole curve separately by Riemann–Roch.
